items.decision_note: Only the freelancer identifies a 50-to-60-second constraint, so it is unclear whether REQ_VIDEO_DURATION is an authoritative client Requirement or merely a feasibility assumption despite the apparent conflict with exact script adherence.

items.reason: Requirement boundaries still changed in the final configured audit round.

The instruction to say the predominantly English supplied script exactly may conflict with the existing Igbo-language requirement, but it is unclear whether the client intended to prohibit Igbo translation or only required faithful adherence after translation.

The client's insistence on the complete script immediately follows the warning that its Igbo translation exceeds 50–60 seconds, but the client does not explicitly remove or relax the duration constraint.

It is unclear whether saying the message-23 script exactly as written requires literal English wording or exact content translated into Igbo; changing the spoken-language requirement would require clarification.
The exact-script instruction may prioritize complete narration over the reported 50–60-second duration, but it does not explicitly cancel or revise that duration constraint.
